newsitem.title: THAILAND: Wattachak says delays dividend payment.
newsitem.headline: Wattachak says delays dividend payment.

text.p: Thai publishing group Wattachak is unable to pay 1996 dividends as scheduled due to financial problems, the company said on Thursday.

"Reference to our letter dated July 3 1997 that we will pay the dividend to our shareholders within July 1997. As you may know we have to face economic and financial problems and therefore cannot make it on time," the firm said in statement.
Wattachak intends to pay the dividend by September, the statement said.
In May Wattachak said it would pay a 0.33 baht per share dividend on its 1996 earnings.
